fusions.name: Wringing Grasp
fusions.desc: Flicks a strand that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets and holds it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Gathering Grip
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile line of strands ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 10 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Self-Sutured
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. Each heal has a 10% chance to be a critical heal, restoring more.

fusions.name: Firm Hold
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
